metadata.freetext_desc: 4-DOF articulated arm on a rotating base (base yaw, shoulder pitch, elbow pitch) with a single-servo parallel gripper; no wrist. Picks one component from a tagged repeatable pickup bin and places it on the conveyor or a named staging zone.

pick.freetext_desc: Move to the given AprilTag's calibrated pickup pose, close the gripper, and lift to a safe height. No wrist: grab orientation is fixed by the arm pose; the bin must present one graspable part at the same position after each pick.

place.freetext_desc: Move to the named calibrated zone (e.g. belt or staging), release the part, and retreat clear before reporting done.

home.freetext_desc: Return the empty arm to its configured home/rest pose.
